summary: FRONTEND-ONLY test of v13 Chunk A (3 fixes) on mobile viewport 390x844 with Abhijit.patil. Ask 1 (Card-per-Section review): PASS — Zygoma/Pterygoid Phase 1 review renders header card [zyg-p1-review] with purple body-outline icon + title 'Zygoma / Pterygoid — Phase 1' + subtitle 'Diagnosis & Treatment Planning' + chevron + config-pill 'Quad zygoma + 2 pterygoid'; sub-sections render as OWN sibling cards outside the header (verified via DOM parentElement equality) with light-purple header strips, icons, and values — Diagnostic Summary (V/3/2/1), Medical Assessment (Immunosuppression None/ASA II), Anaesthesia Plan (GA + LA infiltration), Team Composition (Dr. Patil), plus Zygomatic Region (body_height R:18/L:23, unexpected but valid since seed had this field populated). Empty groups (extraoral, intraoral, radiographic, pre, existing prosthesis, pterygoid, bedrossian, prosthetic-planning, design-checks) all count=0 — confirming per-section hide-when-empty. Ask 2 (Remove Phase 2 tabs): PASS — phase2-tabbed-view / implant-type-tabs / tab-zygoma / tab-pterygoid / tab-conventional / zyg-advanced-clinical all count=0 on /procedures/submit-phase2/6a8337dd64ad3269dc584a69; Torque Achieved + MUA + Post Surgical Radiographs still present. Ask 4 (Zygoma/Pterygoid Access Channel): PASS — after picking Immediate Loading Done for all 5 implants (ZR1, ZR2, ZL1, PR1, PL1), the Access Channel Opening section renders exactly 5 rows with correct labels 'Zygoma R1/R2/L1', 'Pterygoid R1/L1' (via implantDisplayLabel), each with EXACTLY 3 chips in order: Buccal, Occlusal, Palatal — zero occurrences of 'Facial', 'Incisal', 'Lingual' in the entire AC section. Test 6 (conventional regression) validated by CODE INSPECTION at /app/frontend/app/procedures/submit-phase2/[id].tsx L1513-1523: isZygPter regex /^(ZR|ZL|PR|PL)/ correctly gates zygoma-only trio; else-branch falls through to the pre-existing FDI-derived options (Facial always + Occlusal for upper/lower posterior + Incisal/Cingulum for anterior + Lingual for lower posterior + Palatal for upper posterior). Not E2E tested because no seeded conventional case had phase2_preop_completed_at signed — the pure branch logic is straightforward and low-risk. All 5 executable tests pass; the 1 regression test is code-verified.
